title: Bacteriophage Cryopreservation
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iiyccfw

steps.title: Vortex lysed culture
steps.instruction: Vortex the freshly lysed bacteriophage culture for 10 seconds (00:00:10).

steps.title: Aliquot phage into vials
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of phage to each cryogenic vial (phage concentration not specified).

steps.title: Add glycerol to vials
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 20 % glycerol (growcells.com Catalog #MRGE-4002) to each vial containing phage.

steps.title: Freeze vials
steps.instruction: Place the vials immediately into a –80 °C freezer.

steps.title: Thaw and inoculate culture
steps.instruction: Process each vial individually: remove it from the –80 °C freezer, use a sterile pipette tip to scrape a small amount of frozen virus particles into a 20 mL mid‑log bacterial culture, then return the vial to the freezer.

substeps.instruction: Remove one cryogenic vial from the –80 °C freezer.
Using a sterile pipette tip, scrape a small amount of frozen virus particles into a 20 mL mid‑log culture.
Place the cryogenic vial back into the –80 °C freezer immediately.

steps.title: Incubate for lysis
steps.instruction: Allow the inoculated culture to incubate and lyse under constant light conditions appropriate for the specific host culture.
